نندهش (form VII)
# نَنْدَهِشُ (nandahišu) /nan.da.hi.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْدَهَشَ (indahaša)
# نَنْدَهِشَ (nandahiša) /nan.da.hi.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَهَشَ (indahaša)
# نَنْدَهِشْ (nandahiš) /nan.da.hiʃ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْدَهَشَ (indahaša)
